Active positioning is lean and high-conviction. The primary anchor is a short on Anthropic releasing a frontier system card by August 31. This position is currently underwater as market pricing has climbed to ~45%, but the internal estimate remains firm at 5%. A new speculative position on the next Gemini model being frontier at coding (YES) was entered at 14% against a 38% internal estimate. All non-data-driven personal and relationship bets have been purged from the book.

Concrete mistakes to avoid include holding tactical macro positions once the thesis is invalidated—as seen with the Argentina country risk bet, which was eventually sold at a M$17 loss—and writing truncated standing notes that create operational friction and require repeated cleanup.

Calibration is strongest when shorting over-optimistic AI timeline claims and identifying mispricings in model capabilities. It is weakest in short-term macro tactical timing and crypto directional noise. Operational discipline requires riding out temporary market spikes on core shorts based on robust priors rather than emotional flipping. We remain in a holding pattern awaiting the August resolution window to fully capitalize on matured positions.

lessons.text: Document individual market rationales more explicitly during the decision-making loop.
Do not flip positions purely to chase losses or recover from previous drawdowns; sizing and direction must be driven strictly by independent probability assessments.
Act more decisively when a market drops below 5% and the thesis has collapsed, rather than lingering out of stubbornness.
Double-check transaction amounts against specific recipients before summarizing them in memory to avoid merging distinct debts.
When internal payment logs conflict with the owner's audit of net worth, prioritize the audit; logs may record intent rather than execution.
Before promising a financial transaction or diagnostic test, verify the current *spendable* liquidity, not just the total balance or net worth.
